implement.summary: Added apps/mobile/__tests__/w07LifecycleMatrix.test.ts (670 lines, 4 tests) driving the REAL shipping host (startBillingLifecycle + useAccessStore + AppState + fake timers) through an ordered matrix: cold start → restore while offline → 5xx retry → restore fulfilled (premium) → verified horizon passes (grace) → renewal check fails offline (grace preserved, no revoke) → stalled renewal (bounded timeout) → renewal verified with new horizon → unbound non-premium answer stays 'free' (never fabricates 'expired') → purchase verification stall (hold) → held state blocks re-purchase/restore without extra StoreKit calls → bound refund verdict settles → refund survives later network failure → new purchase supersedes refund → transfer-out non-premium answer does not fabricate premium/expiry/refund → restore after transfer-out stays free. Plus: durable restore record with unreachable server (held, exponential backoff, fulfilled without StoreKit); ambiguous 'pending' purchase verdict (stays pending, never settles/recharges, hold on network failure, settles only on a bound expired verdict); unreadable journal beside a remembered purchase. Defect found on BASE_SHA (VERIFIED, test fails on base): apps/mobile/src/billing/lifecycle.ts:44-49 scheduled `selectBillingReconciliationRetryAtMs(state)` directly; when the pending journal could not be read (accessStore.ts loadPending → fulfilmentStatus 'unavailable'), the record's own retry deadline never advances, so the already-overdue value was clamped to MIN_DELAY_MS (lifecycle.ts:8) and the host polled storage every 1 s, ignoring the store's bounded reconciliation backoff (accessStore.ts reconcileBilling catch → tracker.nextAttemptAtMs, 5 s·2^n capped at 5 min). Fix (lifecycle.ts, +25/-2): new `selectRetryAtMs(state)` returns the store's retryAt unchanged except when a pending record exists, reconciliation is 'unavailable', and the record's retryAt ≤ reconciliation.lastAttemptAtMs (i.e. the last pass failed before attempting the record); then it returns max(retryAt, reconciliation.nextAttemptAtMs). Both schedule() and run() use it. No other behaviour changed; invariants preserved (no automatic StoreKit calls, server-authoritative access, owner fencing, bounded retries). Commits: 7e20dfd4 (test, fails on base) then 95a33aff (fix). Branch pushed; no PR opened.
